title.narrative: Number of health facilities providing Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care
People who have received essential health, nutrition, and population (HNP) services
Number of health centers in priority districts that received performance-based allocations in accordance with at least one scorecard assessment with community consultations in the previous FY
Health sub-account expenditures in 28 historically underserved districts
Number of district and rural hospitals that received performance-based allocations in accordance with a minimum of one scorecard assessment in the previous fiscal year
Number of deliveries attended by skilled health personnel
Percentage of deaths in eligible health facilities certified by a doctor or qualified clinician with cause of death coded using ICD10, and the death record captured in the SISMA MGDH
Percentage of children aged 0-24 months receiving a Nutrition Intervention Package in eight priority provinces (with the prevalenceof stunting of above 35 percent)
Health sub-account expenditures in 3 historically underserved provinces (Nampula, Zambezia, and Tete)
Number of women and children who have received basic nutrition services
Number of technical health personnel assigned to the primary health care network
Number of Couple Years of Protection
Number of active community health workers
Number of technical staff assigned to type II rural health centers
Percentage of women who had at least four antenatal visits during their pregnancy
Domestic health expenditures as a percentage of total domestic government expenditures
Percentage of deaths registered, certified and captured in the civil registration system (SiRCEV) within one year of their occurrence
Percentage of secondary and technical schools offering sexual and reproductive health services (information and contraceptive methods)
Number of primary health care facilities that have at least two maternal child health nurses
Number of provinces meeting annual Couple Years of Protection growth targets
Number of lagging districts (as defined in the IC) that provide four doses of intermittent preventive treatment of malaria to at least 60 percent of pregnant women
Number of districts, out of the 42 identified as lagging in the Investment Case, with at least 85 percent institutional deliveries
